nodes.label: Christmastide / Octave of Christmas
nodes.rationale: Christmas, V_Christmas, StStephan, StJohn, StsInnocents, StThomas, StSylvester, Circumcision, octave days.

nodes.label: Commemoration orations (99901-99915)
nodes.rationale: Numeric-ID entries for seasonal/votive collects (Advent weeks, De Spiritu Sancto, BVM by season, Ecclesiae, Pro Papa, A cunctis, Fidelium, ad lib, de feria, Omnipotens) referenced by feasts' commemorations.

nodes.label: 00-00 movable date placeholder
nodes.rationale: Temporal feasts have no fixed date; computed relative to Easter/Advent/Epiphany.

nodes.label: Eastertide
nodes.rationale: Easter, Easter octave, WhitSaturday (Low Sat), D_Easter_1..6, Rogation days, Ascension and its octave.

nodes.label: Ember Days
nodes.rationale: Four sets (Lent, Pentecost, September, Advent) of Wed/Fri/Sat: Ember_*_4/_6/_s.

nodes.label: Epiphany season
nodes.rationale: Epiphany, octave (8_Epiph_f*), HolyFamily, SNameJesus, D_Epiph_1..6 with ferias; resumed Epiphany Sundays after Pentecost (D_Epiph_N_22..).

nodes.label: Temporal feast record schema
nodes.rationale: Fields: id, name_translations{la,en,fr}, date, rank_verbose, rank_numeric, color, office_type, mass_properties{introit,gloria,credo,preface,sequence,proper_last_gospel}, commemorations, nobility[6].

nodes.label: Our Lady on Saturday (S Maria in Sabbato)
nodes.norm_label: our lady on saturday (s maria in sabbato)

nodes.label: Lent & Passiontide
nodes.rationale: Ash Wednesday, D_Lent_1..4, Lenten Embers, D_Passion_5, SevenSorrows, Palm Sunday and Holy Week (de_Palm_f*).

nodes.label: nobility tie-break vector
nodes.rationale: Six-integer list used to break ties between feasts of equal rank (e.g. Lady Saturday [8,2,6,13,3,0]).

nodes.label: Octaves
nodes.rationale: Feasts with octaves (Easter, Pentecost, Ascension, CorpusChristi, SacredHeart, StJoseph, Epiphany, Christmas) generate in_8 days and octave days with graded privilege.

nodes.label: office_type field
nodes.rationale: Values: dominica, feria, festiva, ferial, false, 'ut in pr loco'.

nodes.label: Pentecost & Time after Pentecost
nodes.rationale: V_Pentecost, Pentecost octave, Pentecost Embers, Trinity, D_Pent_2..28 with ferias; ChristKing.

nodes.label: rank_numeric precedence value
nodes.rationale: Integer precedence (1=highest). Common: 3 d II cl, 12, 19, 20 simplex octave days, 23 ordinary ferias/Sundays after Pentecost.

nodes.label: rank_verbose rank code
nodes.rationale: Latin abbreviations: d I cl, d II cl, dm, d, sd, s, feria, plus octave/vigil qualifiers like 'cum Oct privil 3 ord', 'Vig privil I cl'.

nodes.label: Solemnity of St. Joseph (movable, with octave)
nodes.norm_label: solemnity of st. joseph (movable, with octave)

nodes.label: Temporal Cycle (temporal_cycle.yaml)
nodes.rationale: Single YAML list of ~745 movable feasts/ferias of the Tridentine (1962-era) temporal cycle; dates are 00-00 placeholders because positions are computed from Easter/Christmas at runtime.

nodes.label: Temporal feast ID naming convention
nodes.rationale: D_ = Dominica (Sunday), de_ = feria of week, f2..f6/fs = Monday..Saturday, 8_/in_8_ = octave day / within octave, V_ = vigil, _22/_23 suffix = displaced Epiphany Sundays after Pentecost.
